annotations.title: Live planning check for a heat pump or flue at a postcode

description: Looks up, live from official open data, what applies at the customer's postcode before an air source heat pump, a new boiler flue or external pipework: listed buildings, conservation areas, Article 4 directions, World Heritage Sites, National Landscapes, scheduled monuments and flood risk zones (planning.data.gov.uk, England, councils that publish), plus any live Environment Agency flood warnings within 10 km. Returns each constraint found with its source link, whether an air source heat pump is likely permitted development there, what each constraint means for heating and plumbing work, and the council and nation. A constraint not found is not proof of none: the answer says so. Example: {"postcode":"YO1 7HH"}.
name: property_check
title: Live planning check for a heat pump or flue at a postcode
